Yes, you should always penalize text quality for mistakes in the text, even if they were as such in the original. The dimension requires to evaluate presence and quality of text whether it was asked for or not in the prompt. If the output modifies it, and it was not part of the edit request, then you would penalize the preservation of unedited portions.
